descriptionHtml:
AULA F98 Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard (99 Keys Layout / Smart Display Screen / Multi-Function Knob / Hot-Swappable / Ice Crystal Switches / Dynamic RGB)

Elevate your desktop setup and productivity control with the AULA F98 Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard (Knob Version), available now at Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring an efficient 99-key compact layout layout, this premium mechanical keyboard integrates a built-in customizable Smart Display Screen alongside a Multi-Function Volume Knob framework for instantaneous setting adjustments. Engineered with a true Gasket-Mounted structural architecture, it incorporates multi-layered sound-dampening materials to eliminate harsh resonance. Pre-equipped with smooth, transparent Ice Crystal mechanical switches, the full Hot-Swappable PCB layout supports effortless customization across all 3-pin and 5-pin keycaps configurations. The F98 Pro delivers peak connectivity versatility with its high-performance Tri-Mode ecosystem layout—delivering ultra-low latency 2.4GHz wireless tracking, seamless Bluetooth wireless execution, and reliable USB-C wired charging paths. Completely wrapped in a vibrant, customizable dynamic RGB illumination system matrix, this smart keyboard framework provides the ultimate competitive advantage for gaming control and desktop management.
